Maya: Quick sync 1 QuantaChip's S1 boards show worse perf/W after our kernel-k11 change. Alex, can you paste run summary?

QuantaChip-Alex: Run QTC-2026-04-02-S1: 95 tok/s @ 360W => 0.264 tok/W for seq=1024, batch=1, kernel=k11, quant=q4-opt. Baseline (k9,q4-opt) was ~0.33 tok/W. Cmd: `./qc-bench --model rp-standard --seq 1024 --batch 1 --quant q4-opt --kernel k11 --warmup 50`. NVML=1s sampling.

Luca: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) A/B k11 vs k9 with same quant, warmup>=200, NVML=1s, explicit powercap 360W 2) collect hw counters (memcpy_stall, l2_miss) via our perf wrapper.

QuantaChip-Alex: Kicking off A/B now, will attach nvml.csv and perf.json to s3://redwood-partners/quanta/QTC-2026-04-02/ once done.

partner-bench-bot: job QTC-2026-04-02-ab queued. Expected artifacts: nvml.csv, perf.json, logs.tar.gz.

Vera: For GTM: please hold any marketplace card or press until we finalize numbers. If k11 regresses due to eviction path, we need a mitigated number or note on tuning knobs.

partner-bench-bot: job QTC-2026-04-02-ab completed. Artifacts uploaded.

Luca: Quick look: k9+q4-opt -> 110 tok/s @ 335W => 0.328 tok/W. k11+q4-opt -> 96 tok/s @ 358W => 0.268 tok/W. perf.json shows memcpy spikes at token boundaries for k11. Hypothesis: k11 triggers an extra eviction that causes host<->device copies.

Maya: Action items: 1) QuantaChip to try k11 without eviction (patch flag QE_NO_EVICT=1) and re-run. 2) We add checklist item to partner-runbook: "always A/B kernel+quant with warmup>=200, NVML=1s, explicit powercap, perf counters". 3) GTM holds marketplace card until validated artifact.

QuantaChip-Alex: Will run QE_NO_EVICT=1 and upload results by EOD PT. Thanks all.
